item.title: BJP, MLA Abhay Patil Seek Action Against L&T Over Belagavi Water Project Delay
item.description: BJP leaders led by MLA Abhay Patil protest delays in Belagavi’s 24x7 water project. They demand strict action against L&T as only 14 of 58 wards get round-the-clock water.

item.title: Belagavi Elderly Businessman Duped of ₹15 Crore in ‘Digital Arrest’ Cyber Scam
item.description: An elderly businessman in Belagavi lost ₹15 crore in a cyber fraud after scammers threatened him with a fake digital arrest. Police have frozen ₹90 lakh and launched an investigation.

item.title: Jarkiholi Highlights Waste Crisis and Irrigation Delays in Belagavi
item.description: Public Works Minister Satish Jarkiholi raises concern over Belagavi’s long-pending waste issue, irrigation project delays, and water loss from Hipparagi barrage.

item.title: Gadkari Asks Audit Before Approving VTMS for NWKRTC Buses
item.description: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari says ₹29.39 crore VTMS proposal for NWKRTC buses will be approved only after full audit of the earlier project is submitted.

item.title: Belagavi’s 1,000-Acre Industrial Land Bank Plan Stalled, ₹28,000 Crore Investments Hit
item.description: Belagavi’s proposed 1,000-acre industrial land bank remains stalled since 2014, delaying ₹28,000 crore investments and hindering industrial growth in the region.

item.title: Belagavi Police Flag 1,400 Mule Accounts; Cyber Fraud Cases Across States
item.description: Belagavi police have identified 1,400 suspected mule accounts linked to cyber fraud. Multiple cases across states reveal transactions worth over ₹1 crore.
